description: The SaaS products that fit the need, best first, scored by TypeSafe (fitPct 0 to 100). Each call scores at most 8 new listings. When `remaining` is more than 0, call again with the same need and categories to score the next ones. Without categories, the tool finds the category of the need first. When the need fits more than one category, it returns `choices`: call again with one or two of them. Each result has vendorPrice: the price that the vendor states, not a price of Shortlist SaaS.

categories.description: One or two category slugs from list_categories. Leave it out to let the tool find the category of the need.

need.description: What the person needs from a SaaS product, in plain words. For example: track the visits to my website.
